tool_runtime.scope: process runtime/file-progress budget, not proof of algorithm deadlock or hardware acceptance

physical_memories.scope: post-PNR storage accounting only; routing failure and timing acceptance remain separate

global_allocation.scope: reported global assignment only; individual BUFG index and route delays require separate evidence

global_loads.scope: actual flat-netlist direct loads and reported global assignment; not route status, congestion or identification of unrouted nets

previous_global_loads.scope: actual flat-netlist direct loads and reported global assignment; not route status, congestion or identification of unrouted nets

limitations: high load counters do not identify failed nets
